subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK plus TUI render path, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses TUI rendering, public config, provider credentials/usage, and Plugin SDK boundaries, and current related PRs intentionally cover only narrower slices.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Approve the PluginStatusProvider direction first, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage footer fields behind that supported extension boundary.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui` footer template/config surface and accept the schema, docs, migration, and compatibility burden for persistent footer customization.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Keep `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and decline persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Approve the PluginStatusProvider direction first, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage footer fields behind that supported extension boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history spans usage footer modes, provider usage hooks, and plugin architecture commits authored by Peter Steinberger.
